name: wowdeck-backend
description: Standalone WoW addon management engine for the WoWDeck Addon Manager Decky plugin

scripts.build:binaries: mkdir -p out && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 src/main.ts --outfile out/wowdeck-x86_64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile out/wowdeck-aarch64
